situation: A tenant applying for a passport has an Aadhaar that still shows an older address, and the utility bills at the current flat are in the landlord's name.

remedies_reported.name: Update the Aadhaar address to the current one before applying
Show the rent agreement together with a utility bill for the flat, even if the bill is in the landlord's name
Get a letter from the landlord confirming the stay
Make sure neighbours or building security know the applicant, since police may ask them

conflict_note: The blog says unregistered or informal rent agreements can raise doubts. MEA's 2017 office memorandum says passport offices must also accept unregistered rent agreements as valid address proof.

source.title: OnGrid: Documents for passport police verification in India

your_summary: A blog on preparing for police verification. It says most delays come from details that do not match across documents rather than missing papers. Its advice to renters: make the application address match the proof, update an outdated Aadhaar first, keep the rent agreement with the bills, and be known to neighbours.
